message: The other day, I found myself knee-deep in a storm prep panic, rummaging through the pantry for non-perishables, only to discover I had a whole collection of expired cans. Who knew I was sitting on a treasure trove of, um, vintage soup? 🌪️ It’s funny how a little chaos can remind you to check your supplies every now and then. Have you ever found something in your stash that made you laugh (or cringe)?
